source.description:
Research finding: 'Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR' got 87pts on HN — automated ticket→PR workflow is valuable.

**Action items:**
1. Enhance `xt end` to auto-generate PR description from:
   - bd show <id> (title, description, acceptance criteria)
   - git diff --stat (files changed)
   - GitNexus detect_changes (affected symbols/flows)
2. Auto-link beads issues in PR body: 'Closes bd-123'
3. Auto-suggest reviewers based on file territory (service-registry.json)
4. Add --dry-run to preview PR before creating
5. Support GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket via existing xt remote

**Example output:**
```
xt end --pr
# Creates PR with:
# - Title from bead
# - Description from bead + changes summary
# - 'Closes bd-123' link
# - Suggested reviewers: @dawid (specialists territory)
```

**Why this matters:** 
- Reduces friction from close→push→PR
- Ensures PR descriptions have proper context
- Auto-reviewer assignment speeds up merges

**Source:** last30days research on AI coding agents (HN: Optio project)
